sentences.text: `` Beautiful '' is a song recorded by American singer Christina Aguilera for her fourth studio album , Stripped -LRB- 2002 -RRB- .	Christina Aguilera	Christina Aguilera	Stripped	Stripped (Christina Aguilera album)	studio album	studio album
It was released as the album 's second single on November 16 , 2002 .
A pop and R&B ballad , `` Beautiful '' was written and produced by Linda Perry .	R&B	Contemporary R&B	Linda Perry	Linda Perry	pop	Pop music	ballad	ballad
Lyrically , it discusses inner beauty , as well as self-esteem and insecurity issues .
Aguilera commented that she put `` her heart and her soul '' into the track , which she felt represented the theme of Stripped .	Stripped	Stripped (Christina Aguilera album)
The song was later re-recorded in an electronic style for her first greatest hits album Keeps Gettin ' Better : A Decade of Hits -LRB- 2008 -RRB- .	electronic	Electronic music
Upon its release , `` Beautiful '' received universal acclaim from music critics , who have ranked it among Aguilera 's strongest material .

It won a Grammy Award for Best Female Pop Vocal Performance and was also nominated for Song of the Year at the 2004 ceremony .	Pop	Pop music	Grammy Award	Grammy Award	Best Female Pop Vocal Performance	Grammy Award for Best Female Pop Vocal Performance	Song of the Year	Grammy Award for Song of the Year	2004 ceremony	46th Annual Grammy Awards
`` Beautiful '' was also a commercial success , topping the charts in Australia , Belgium , Canada , Ireland , New Zealand and the United Kingdom .
The song peaked at number two on the Billboard Hot 100 in the United States , where it was certified Gold for 500,000 units shipped .	Gold	RIAA certification
It was kept from the number one spot by `` Bump , Bump , Bump '' by B2K featuring P. Diddy .	B2K	B2K	P. Diddy	P. Diddy
`` Beautiful '' has been widely embraced as an anthem by the LGBT community for its message of self-empowerment and inner beauty .	anthem	Gay anthem	LGBT community	LGBT community

An accompanying music video was directed by Jonas Åkerlund , and earned Aguilera a GLAAD Media Award for its positive portrayal of gay and transgender people .	Jonas Åkerlund	Jonas Åkerlund	GLAAD Media Award	GLAAD Media Award	gay	Homosexuality	transgender	transgender

In 2011 , UK LGBT rights organization Stonewall named `` Beautiful '' the most empowering song of the previous decade for gay , lesbian , and bisexual people .	gay	Homosexuality	Stonewall	Stonewall (charity)	lesbian	lesbian	bisexual	Bisexuality
In 2009 , Rolling Stone and VH1 listed it as one of the best songs of the 2000s -LRB- decade -RRB- .	Rolling Stone	Rolling Stone	VH1	VH1
The song is widely recognized as one of Aguilera 's signature songs and has been covered on numerous occasions and featured on several television shows .
